title: Interested in Southern Lights, January 23-25, 2026, or already coming? Lots of information here
excerpt: Dear Southern Lighter, We hope you are having a fantastic Holiday Season so far. Below are reminders — and a few very important updates. Please read everything carefully. If a question comes up, check our FAQ page. Still can't find the answer? Reach out — we're happy to help.…
body:
Dear Southern Lighter,

We hope you are having a fantastic Holiday Season so far.

Below are reminders — and a few very important updates. Please read everything carefully.

If a question comes up, check our [FAQ page](https://southernlightsconference.com/faqs). Still can't find the answer? [Reach out](https://southernlightsconference.com/contact) — we're happy to help.

GIVE SOUTHERN LIGHTS AS A CHRISTMAS GIFT (Everyone) — 20% Discount!

Know someone you've been telling about Southern Lights who's never attended — on-site or virtual? Here's how you can change that. Give a registration as a gift and receive 20% off each gifted registration. [Click here](https://southernlightsconference.com/giftcards). Bring a spouse, best friend, adult child — or bless someone who otherwise couldn't afford it or needs a gentle nudge.

WHEN & WHERE DO I REGISTER? (In-person)

Fri, January 23 · 9:00 AM–2:00 PM — Strickland Auditorium. After 2:00 PM, register at the bookstore in the Strickland lobby. [Campus map](https://www.epworthbythesea.org/).

LODGING CHECK-IN AT EPWORTH (In-person)

Check in at the Administrative Office (see [map](https://www.epworthbythesea.org/)). Official check-in time is 4:00 PM, but you may check in upon arrival; your room will be assigned when ready. Room not ready? Leave luggage in the lobby and enjoy the island vibes.

VIRTUAL VIEWING (Virtual)

Your email with the broadcast link + password will arrive by noon on Thu, January 22. Watch on a phone, tablet, or computer; Apple TV users can mirror to their TV. Pro tip: use Wi-Fi + power for a smooth stream.

WHAT'S IN THE VIRTUAL STREAM? (Virtual)

All Main Sessions (1–6) + Speakers' Panel. Saturday Night Event. Homily & Eucharist Service.

ON-DEMAND ACCESS (Everyone)

Everyone will receive a link the morning of February 5 for on-demand viewing. Access to all sessions, the Speakers' Panel, Saturday Night Event, and Sunday Service will be available until April 30 for you to view and re-view at your leisure.

CAN FRIENDS STILL REGISTER? (Everyone)

Yes — live or virtual, via [Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/southern-lights-conference-2026-registration-1138009349599). On-site housing is very limited, but nearby hotels and Airbnbs abound. Check our FAQ for suggestions.

JOIN THE CONVERSATION (Everyone)

Are you a Southern Lights alum? Want to share your experience or meet new friends online? Follow us for speaker highlights, guiding questions, this year's speaker quotes and more: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/southernlightsconference/?hl=en), Bluesky @southernlightsconf.bsky.social.

MEAL PACKAGES AT EPWORTH (In-person, Off-site)

Staying off campus but want to dine with the group? Yes! [Purchase here](https://fs21.formsite.com/Epworthssi/kqhvwutzm9/index).

UPDATED SCHEDULE (Everyone)

Find the latest schedule (updated as sessions finalize): [https://southernlightsconference.com/schedule](https://southernlightsconference.com/schedule). Updates will be posted as information is available.

YOGA RETURNS! (In-person)

Gentle morning yoga Saturday & Sunday with Belinda Lennon. We'll have 20+ mats available — or bring your own. [Learn more](https://southernlightsconference.com/speakers/blennon).

IN CLOSING

We wish you a blessed Advent and a very Merry Christmas — and leave you with this poem —

Advent

We wait,
not because we are certain,
but because the dark
has not prevailed.

A small light is coming—
learning our names.
It does not hurry.
It does not break the door.

Hope comes this way:
not crowned,
not shouting,
but close as breath
in the long night.

So we keep watch.
Even now,
light is on its way.
— Anonymous

— The Southern Lights Team
